references.text: Jeremiah prophesies about God's wrath striking all age groups—children, young people, and the elderly together—the same pattern of comprehensive judgment over all generations.
Jeremiah mentions that God will break both young men and virgins, old and young, the same groups mentioned in the Deuteronomy text.
Ezekiel describes how judgment will strike old men, young men, virgins, children, and women—an expansion of the same theme of total destruction.
2 Chronicles mentions how war and sword strike the people, with reference to both internal and external dangers.
Isaiah prophesies about Babylon's fall where young men and infants are killed, a parallel to the description of total destruction.
Leviticus warns of the sword bringing vengeance and pestilence within the cities, the same motif of sword from without and terror from within.
